takeaway: Thawing permafrost releases carbon that causes warming, which thaws more permafrost.
explain_script: Warming thaws frozen ground, which lets microbes release the carbon trapped inside it. That released carbon warms the planet further, which thaws even more ground. Scientists disagree about how fast this cycle can run.
